# Guidance (`spells:guidance`)
**[Divination](../magic-schools/divination.md) Cantrip (Concentration)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Touch Component: V, S
**Components:**  | **Duration:** up to 1 minute | **Classes:** [Cleric](../classes/cleric.md), [Druid](../classes/druid.md)

You touch a willing creature and choose a skill. Until the spell ends, the creature adds 1d4 to any ability check using the chosen skill.
